chunks: Aban narrated from Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
When the young boy steals and has not reached puberty, the tips of his fingers are cut. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) was the only one who did this, and I [also did it].

key_terms.يَحْتَلِم: To reach puberty (specifically via nocturnal emission)

ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for a child who steals before reaching puberty in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Istibsar clarifies that the hadd punishment for theft in a pre-pubescent boy (sabiy) involves amputating the tips of the fingers rather than the hand, a ruling uniquely attributed to the Prophet and Imam al-Sadiq (AS). This distinction highlights the Shia jurisprudential view that the full hand amputation applies only upon reaching maturity, while the child receives a lesser corporal penalty as a form of discipline and deterrence.
